# React Native Google Sign In

> Google Sign-In for React Native and Expo apps (Android, iOS, macOS, web). Package: @react-native-google-signin/google-signin

## Overview

`@react-native-google-signin/google-signin` provides Google authentication for React Native and Expo apps.

There are two modules:
- **Universal Sign In** (recommended, [paid](https://universal-sign-in.com/#pricing)): Cross-platform API using Android Credential Manager and iOS Google Sign-In SDK. Module name: `GoogleOneTapSignIn`.
- **Original Google Sign In** (free): Legacy API for Android and iOS only. Module name: `GoogleSignin`.

## Quick start

1. Install the package (see Installation)
2. Collect configuration (see Configuration guide)
3. Follow the setup guide for your platform (Expo, Android, iOS, or Web)
4. Use the Universal Sign In API (see Universal sign in)

- [Expo setup](https://react-native-google-signin.github.io/docs/setting-up/expo): Expo setup guide. Covers config plugin setup and EAS Build configuration for Google Sign-In.
- [Android setup guide](https://react-native-google-signin.github.io/docs/setting-up/android): Android setup guide for vanilla React Native apps (not Expo). Covers Google project configuration, linking, and Credential Manager setup.
- [iOS setup guide](https://react-native-google-signin.github.io/docs/setting-up/ios): iOS setup guide for vanilla React Native apps (not Expo). Covers native module linking, URL schemes, and plist configuration.
- [Web setup guide](https://react-native-google-signin.github.io/docs/setting-up/web): Web setup guide. Works with NextJS, Vite, and other web frameworks. Covers Google client ID configuration and script loading.
- [Universal sign in](https://react-native-google-signin.github.io/docs/one-tap): Google's recommended Sign-In API for Android (Credential Manager), iOS/macOS (Google Sign-In SDK), and web. Covers configuration, sign-in flows, us...
- [Web support](https://react-native-google-signin.github.io/docs/web-support): Web platform support. Works with NextJS, Vite, and other web frameworks without React Native Web dependency. Covers setup, rendering modes, and lim...
- [Advanced security](https://react-native-google-signin.github.io/docs/security): Advanced security features: custom nonce support on all platforms and App Check for iOS.
- [GoogleLogoButton](https://react-native-google-signin.github.io/docs/buttons/google-logo-button): GoogleLogoButton component following Google's official branding guidelines. For native apps only (renders null on web). Customizable size, style, a...
- [WebGoogleSigninButton](https://react-native-google-signin.github.io/docs/buttons/web): WebGoogleSigninButton component for web apps. Renders null in native apps. Supports size, shape, theme, and locale customization.
- [Error handling](https://react-native-google-signin.github.io/docs/errors): Error handling guide. Covers isErrorWithCode helper, error codes (SIGN_IN_CANCELLED, NO_SAVED_CREDENTIAL_FOUND, PLAY_SERVICES_NOT_AVAILABLE, etc.),...
- [Testing](https://react-native-google-signin.github.io/docs/testing): How to mock Google Sign-In in Jest tests for both the Universal and Original modules.
- [FAQ / Troubleshooting](https://react-native-google-signin.github.io/docs/troubleshooting): Common issues and solutions for Android (DEVELOPER_ERROR, cancelled results) and iOS (missing profile data, URL schemes).
- [Migration guides](https://react-native-google-signin.github.io/docs/migrating): Migration guides: from Original to Universal Sign In module, and from the legacy JS API to the new API.
- [Configuration Doctor](https://react-native-google-signin.github.io/docs/config-doctor): CLI tool to diagnose Android signing configuration issues and resolve DEVELOPER_ERROR.
- [API reference](https://react-native-google-signin.github.io/docs/api): > **AuthorizationResponse** = [`CancelledResponse`](#cancelledresponse) \| [`AuthorizationSuccessResponse`](#authorizationsuccessresponse)
